tasks.body: Implement plan.md Task A. Export slugify(input) from src/slugify.mjs: return a lowercase slug where every run of characters that is not an ASCII letter or digit becomes a single '-', leading and trailing separators are removed, and input with no ASCII letters or digits becomes ''. Do not transliterate diacritics; non-ASCII letters are separators. Add test/slugify.test.mjs using node:test and node:assert/strict covering every acceptance line: slugify("Hello, World!") === "hello-world"; slugify("  a  --  b  ") === "a-b"; slugify("!!!") === ""; slugify("a_b") === "a-b"; the input is never mutated. Add no dependencies. Done means the repository's full 'npm test' passes, not only test/slugify.test.mjs. Run 'npm test' from the repository root and report its complete output.

Implement plan.md Task B. Export titleCase(input) from src/titleCase.mjs: uppercase the first letter of every word and leave every other character exactly as it was; never lowercase anything. Only ASCII letters (A-Z, a-z) count as letters for titleCase, the same rule Task A uses for slugify; non-ASCII letters are not letters, so they are never changed and they count as word boundaries. A word starts at the beginning of the string or after any character that is not an ASCII letter or digit (underscore counts as a boundary). Add test/titleCase.test.mjs using node:test and node:assert/strict covering every acceptance line: titleCase("hello world") === "Hello World"; titleCase("iOS device") === "IOS Device"; titleCase("a-b c_d") === "A-B C_D"; titleCase("") === "". Add no dependencies. Done means the repository's full 'npm test' passes, not only test/titleCase.test.mjs. Run 'npm test' from the repository root and report its complete output.
